author: nbasuperstar133
body:
• IGN: nbasuperstar133
  • I was permanent banned because of hacking with kill aura.
  • I should be unbanned because to play with people on the server to have fun and make new friends on the server and staffs.
  • My ban was true because I was hacking in a team game and I use kill aura to cheat in the game and found out it make everyone no play with me.
  • No proof, but I have told the truth.
  • It is been 6 or 7 months that I was unbanned I have been waiting patiently.
  • I have been caught by cheating by evading the games that I joined.
  • Never been ban off this server, but I just did for the first time.


  • One thing I have to say that I am sorry for hacking on your server and learn my lesson and I want to come on the server to have fun and make new friends!!!
